hooks.name: Re-check evidence after a spec or test changes
hooks.description: A verdict is only true for the revision it was computed on. When the spec or the suite is edited, the report is regenerated so it cannot silently go stale.

action.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m proveit check --spec .kiro/specs/prove-it --tests tests --md-out docs/evidence-report.md --json-out docs/evidence-report.json

hooks.name: Write the evidence report when the session stops
hooks.description: Leaves the verdict on disk at the end of a session, so the last state of the spec is always recorded.

action.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m proveit check --spec .kiro/specs/prove-it --tests tests --md-out docs/evidence-report.md --json-out docs/evidence-report.json
